name: As Above, So Below
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
narrative.objectives: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
narrative.requestItemsText: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
